_doc: A-CLASS metrics (monitoring plan §2 / 阶段1): short-window counts / latency / distributions
extracted from the gateway's metric:true JSON log lines via CloudWatch Logs metric-filters,
so dashboards read CHEAP pre-extracted METRICS (not raw-log scans) and alarms can use them.
B-class (DAU/retention de-dup) is NOT here — see ../insights/ (it needs a scheduled pre-aggregation
Lambda, never a real-time dashboard log-dedup widget).
Each entry is consumed by scripts/apply-metric-filters.sh: it creates one metric-filter on the
gateway log group (logGroup below) emitting `metric` into namespace `metricNamespace`.
DENSITY rules (and a hard CloudWatch constraint):
- Plain counters (no dimensions) set defaultValue:0 so the metric is DENSE (emits 0 when no
match) and alarms judge stably (plan 阶段3).
- Latency/distribution metrics (metricValue is a $.field, not 1) have NO defaultValue (a
percentile over absent data is meaningless).
- DIMENSIONED metrics MUST NOT set defaultValue — CloudWatch rejects defaultValue together
with dimensions, and a dimensioned metric is inherently SPARSE (a dimension value's stream
only gets points when that value appears). These are for dashboard breakdown; for stable
rate-alarming on a specific dimension value, 阶段3 adds a dedicated dense per-value filter.
apply-metric-filters.sh ENFORCES the constraint (fails loud if an entry has both).
filterPattern uses the CloudWatch metric-filter JSON syntax — NOT Logs-Insights syntax (the two
are not interchangeable; plan 原则3). CRITICAL: string fields match with $.field = "x", but JSON
BOOLEANS match with $.field IS TRUE / IS FALSE — `$.metric = true` matches the STRING "true", not
the boolean, so it would silently match ZERO of the gateway's `"metric":true` lines (validated via
aws logs test-metric-filter). The single source of metric INTENT is this file; the Insights
equivalents (for ad-hoc drill-down) live alongside in ../insights/.

metrics.name: QuestionsReceived
metrics.purpose: 用量趋势 / 提问量 (DAU itself is B-class, see insights/)

metrics.name: AnswerCompleted
metrics.purpose: 成功完成数 (反馈覆盖率/点赞率的分母)

metrics.name: AnswerLatencyMs
metrics.purpose: 总延迟 — 看 p50/p95/p99 extended statistic, 不看平均 (plan 原则5)

metrics.name: FirstTokenMs
metrics.purpose: 首字延迟 (体感关键) — p95

metrics.name: RuntimeColdStarts
metrics.purpose: 冷启动频率：落在全新 session(无暖 microVM)的 invoke 数。冷启动占比 = RuntimeColdStarts / QuestionsReceived

metrics.name: RuntimeColdStartMs
metrics.purpose: 冷启动耗时 (microVM spin-up + 路由折进首字时间) — 看 p50/p95，与暖启动延迟分开

metrics.name: EvidenceCitations
metrics.purpose: 证据覆盖率 — avg + (>0 占比 via a 2nd filter if needed)

metrics.name: ToolCalls
metrics.purpose: 每答工具调用数（代码检索充分度）

metrics.name: ToolErrors
metrics.purpose: 每答工具错误数 (is_error 的 tool_result，已恢复非致命) — 高于 ToolCalls 一定比例=检索抖动/工具入参差

metrics.name: TurnCount
metrics.purpose: 每答 agent 循环轮次 (num_turns) — 与 ToolCalls 一起区分慢答是『少而深的模型轮次』还是『多次工具往返』

metrics.name: AnswerFailed
metrics._sparse: NO defaultValue: CloudWatch forbids defaultValue together with dimensions (a dimensioned metric only emits on a match → inherently sparse). For STABLE rate-alarming on a specific failure mode, add a dedicated per-reason filter WITH defaultValue:0 in 阶段3 (same approach as card_health kinds). This dimensioned metric is for dashboard breakdown, not alarms.
metrics.purpose: 失败分布 by reason — 仅真故障, NOT 含 aborted (中止单独画, 否则虚高失败率)

metrics.name: AnswerAborted
metrics.purpose: 中止率 (用户主动停止, 独立于失败 — 对齐 metrics.ts 的 answer_aborted 拆分)

metrics.name: ClarifyShown
metrics.purpose: 澄清触发数 (歧义问题占比)

metrics.name: FeedbackVoted
metrics._sparse: NO defaultValue with dimensions (CloudWatch constraint). Sparse breakdown for the dashboard; up/down ratios are computed from the two dimension streams.
metrics.purpose: 点赞率 = vote=up / (up+down); 反馈覆盖率 = FeedbackVoted / AnswerCompleted

metrics.name: FeedbackReason
metrics._sparse: NO defaultValue with dimensions (CloudWatch constraint). Sparse by design.

metrics.name: CardHealth
metrics._sparse: NO defaultValue with dimensions (CloudWatch constraint) — this dimensioned metric is SPARSE (a kind's stream only gets points when that kind fires). kind is low-cardinality (5) so the dimension is safe, but for STABLE alarming on toolcall_leak_detected / finalize_failed, 阶段3 adds a dedicated per-kind filter WITH defaultValue:0 (dense) per the plan. This metric is for the dashboard breakdown.
metrics._alarm: toolcall_leak_detected / finalize_failed 超阈值 → 告警 (plan 阶段3, 专用稠密 filter).
metrics.purpose: 卡片健康 by kind (工具调用泄漏剥离/卡片未正常结束/重复回答/幂等重发拦截/心跳停滞)
